## 1. Purpose and scope

Define original internal rules for this learning workflow. These requirements are authored project choices; they are not ISO text, an exhaustive external duty set or an additional numbered member of the twelve planned architectural standards. They become organizational rules only through scoped adoption.

## 2. Roles and requirements

| ORR ID | Original requirement | Receiver / evidence |
|---|---|---|
| ORR-REQ-GEN-001 | The intake owner assigns an identifier, scope and receiving owner before routing a concern for decision. | Receiving owner / intake entry and receipt |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-002 | The assigned assessor records the intended objective, specific risk and missing information before proposing treatment. | Process owner / assessment |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-003 | The proposed control identifies a performing role, action, trigger, place/process, purpose, method/criterion and retained evidence. | Decision authority / control statement |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-004 | When a procedure changes, its owner lists affected forms and records their review before releasing the revised procedure. | Document controller / impact list and review |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-005 | The decision authority records accepted actions, responsible owners, due triggers and unresolved conditions before communicating the decision. | Action owners / decision and receipt |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-006 | The action owner records implementation evidence separately from evidence that the intended result was achieved. | Scoped reviewer / two separately identified evidence sets |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-007 | The reviewer keeps an action open when required outcome evidence is missing; only the delegated authority can close it after receiving an adequate review. | Decision authority / criterion, evidence and reasoned disposition |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-008 | The record custodian preserves the original entry when correcting a decision and links the new value, actor, reason and date. | Future reviewer / correction trail |

## 3. Implementation and interfaces

Apply the linked process, procedure, form and register to the adopted scope. Configure actual competence, delegation, confidentiality and urgency routes. Role combination requires a recorded conflict assessment; author self-checks are not independent assurance. Each requirement needs actual scoped receiving evidence; a completed example is not that evidence.

## 4. Reference mapping boundary

| ORR ID | Proposed reference pointer | Status / limitation |
|---|---|---|
| ORR-REQ-GEN-004 | ISO 9001:2015, 7.5.2 and 7.5.3 | Proposed bibliographic pointers only; exact relationship, edition/amendment applicability and completeness not verified |
| ORR-REQ-GEN-006 and 007 | ISO 9001:2015, 10.2 | Proposed pointer only; not a paraphrase of, or evidence of satisfying, every condition in the clause |

Do not import a clause-by-clause source transcription or call these pointers a verified conformity matrix. An authorized competent reviewer must consult lawfully available applicable sources using permitted methods and record the mapping rationale, exact edition, review date and limits before upgrading mapping status. The selected 2015 reference is not a claim that it is the latest edition. The standalone ORR rules can be evaluated without claiming ISO conformity.

## 5. Verification, exceptions and records

Use the assurance protocol to test each selected ORR criterion. Missing scope/authority/evidence holds the corresponding decision. A proposed departure identifies the rule, rationale, risk, compensating arrangement, owner, expiry and decision; internal approval cannot waive an external obligation. Preserve assessments, approvals, implementation, outcome review and correction history under actual private record controls.

## 6. Sources and history

Original role/action/evidence rules created for this public learning example. Reference identifiers contain no source requirement text. r01: original rules and explicitly unverified pointers; no independent legal or normative review claimed.
